title: The Final Verdict
author: Noor Reyes
blurb: Noor Nystrom, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
